description: Update MoonBit module imports in moon.mod from mooncakes.io; Renovate has no MoonBit manager of its own. Use it with "extends": ["github>gaato/.github:moonbit"].

customManagers.description: moon.mod imports are "owner/name@version" strings. moon resolves them with minimal version selection, so the version is a floor and there is no lock file to refresh.

mooncakes.description: Yanked versions are dropped. The registry dates only its latest version, so only that one carries a release timestamp.
transformTemplates: {"releases": versions[yanked = false].{"version": version, "releaseTimestamp": version = $$.version ? $$.metadata.created_at : undefined}, "sourceUrl": metadata.repository, "homepage": "https://mooncakes.io/docs/" & module}

packageRules.description: Modules released together from one repository (mbt-sdk, codecs.mbt) are usually only compatible at matching versions, so they move in one PR.
